instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Most of the things that we do every day use electricity - we are surrounded by it! Electricity from a power outlet is most commonly converted into heat or light. A heater warms up a room, a kettle boils water, an oven cooks our food and a lamp gives us light. Energy is needed for all of this, but it has to be generated in the first place.

atoms.a: Which of these things need energy?
b: sofa, table, chair, window and door
++headphones, bus, traffic light, printer and blender

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

hint.text: When talking about resources from our planet, we usually mean natural raw materials such as minerals, drinking water or energy — things that do not exist in infinite quantities.
hint.label: Resources

atoms.text: Energy is not infinitely available, and most methods of generating electricity are not good for the environment. When we save energy or do not use so much energy in the first place, we save our resources and, therefore, our planet. We also save money, because energy costs money.

atoms.a: How can we conserve Earth’s resources?
b: by using the same amount of energy

instruction.text: How can we save energy? Select the image that matches the advice.

atoms.a: Switch off devices if they are not being used for a long time.
Put on a jumper instead of turning up the heating.
Don’t drive a car if you can walk or cycle instead.
When buying devices, make sure that they consume less energy.

instruction.text: How can we save energy? Select the image that matches the advice.

atoms.a: Only use the washing machine when it is full.
Turn down the heating when no one is home.
Switch off extension leads when they are not being used.
Switch off lights when you are not at home or when you go to sleep.
How can you save energy in the kitchen?
b: ++don’t leave the fridge open for too long.

atoms.a: How can you save energy while cooking?
b: Leave the oven open while baking.
++Put a lid on the pot while cooking. This way, not as much heat can escape.
++Use the remaining heat from the oven to heat up other things.

atoms.a: How can you save energy while shopping?
b: Not buying food that is really heavy.
++Not buying food that has to be transported from far away.
++Not buying food that has a lot of packaging.
